info.name: Authored feedback (Buffer A trail -> Image)
info.description: Hand-authored OWN test export. No third-party shader. Buffer A reads ITSELF on iChannel0 (feedback/accumulation trail). Image reads Buffer A and shows it. An external texture channel exercises the supply-your-own path.

renderpass.name: Buffer A
renderpass.description: Accumulates a fading trail by reading its own previous frame on iChannel0.

renderpass.name: Image
renderpass.description: Shows Buffer A on iChannel0; an external texture is bound on iChannel1.
